main_text.l: onf zobe to lace binnan ham zetxlde
be ham yr rpde menizpealo zetac-
nunz. ȝ pæɼ bebodon ƿ re tæzel rce-
olde beon zehal æfne on ham nÿtene æt pæne orfpunge.
fon pæpe zetac-nunze ƿ zoo pile ƿ pæ rimle pel don
oð ende upeɼ liper. þonne biȝ re tæ-
zel zeorffnoð on upum peopcum.•
Nu ir reo soneræde boc on manegum
stopum spiðe ◦ næpolice gefett.
ȝ þeah spiðe seoplice on þam
ȝarzlicum anbyzte. ȝ heo ir spa ȝeendebyndra spa spa god silf
hi ȝebihte þam pnitesne moise ȝ þe ne bunnon na mape
appitan on englirc þonne ƿ liben hæfþ
ne þa enðebypðnirre apentan buton þam
anum þæt ƿ leben ȝ ƿ englirc nabbaþ
ne ane piɼan on þæpe ɼpnæce ȝan-
bunȝe. æfne re þe apent. oþþe re þe
tæcþ of lebene on englirc æfne he
rceal geɼaðian hit ɼpa ƿ þæt englirc
hæbbe hiɼ agene piɼan eller. hit biþ
ɼpiðe ȝebpolþum to nædenne þam þe
þæɼ lebenep
piɼan ne can.•
Ir eac to pitanne ƿ rume ȝebpol-
men pæþon þe polþon apunpan þa ealban
æ. ȝ rume polþon habban þa ȝ
apinpan þa nipam ɼpa ɼpa þa iudeiscan
boþ. ac cpiɼt ɼylf ȝ hiɼ apoɼtolaɼ uɼ
plicem servorum Dei pulchritudi-
nem designârunt. Pili caprini ri-
gidam hominum de peccatis do-
lentium poenitentiam denotârunt.
Plurima quinetiam animalium ge-
nera Deo in Tabernaculo sacrifica-
bant: cujus instituti ratio est mul-
tiplex. Et praeceptum est ut cau-
da bestiae in oblatione semper esset
integra; ut significaretur Deum
velle, ut ad extremum usque vitae
terminum bene faceremus; quippe
cùm cauda in operibus nostris of-
fertur.
Liber praedictus in multis locis
clarissimè conscribitur; valdè pro-
fundus tamen est in mystico sensu.
Et ita quidem conditur; prout
Deus ipse Mosi scriptori ejus dic-
tavit. Neque audemus amplius
quid scribere Anglicè, quàm in
Latino habetur; neque ordinem
immutare, nisi in hoc duntaxat;
quùm Latinus & Anglicus sermo
eandem loquendi formam non ob-
servent. Qui interpretatur aut do-
cet Latina Anglicè [reddere] eam
semper methodum observare de-
bet; ut Anglicus sermo suum idio-
ma teneat. Aliter lectio in pluri-
mos errores inducet illos; qui idio-
ma Latinum non intelligunt.
Sciendum autem est, nonnullos
fuisse Haereticos; qui Veterem Le-
gem rejiciebant. Iltam aliqui re-
tineri, & Novam rejici, volue-
runt: quod Judaei faciunt. Chri-
: Forsan neapolice legendum, id est, brevissimè

page.notes: Only the left part of the scan is transcribed; the right part is cut off or blanked. The Old English type is Anglo-Saxon printing with thorn, eth and yogh; several words are doubtful and the letters of the bottom line are partly lost. Running head partly cut off. The text is cut off at the left and the lower part of the page is blanked; the foot note line is partly cut. "Sacris Vernaculis." running head and 385 page number read from the top. Doubtful: "Iltam" and "Forsan neapolice" are as far as legible. Word "tabernaculo" with a capital T ornament left as printed.
